subject: Champion briefing: SLA exception & MAP action roll-forward

From: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@novaplace.com>

Cc: ops@novaplace.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP checkpoint + temporary SLA relief during evaluation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We kicked off a higher-than-expected batch of evaluation jobs overnight and saw token-generation times spike to ~4.2s per token for some long-context flows. That pushed a couple of internal SLAs over our acceptable window.

Can Redwood provide a short-term SLA exception or prioritized capacity for the evaluation runs scheduled this week (May 9–12)? We want to keep the evaluation momentum and avoid re-running costly data prep. If needed, we're happy to sign a short amendment or pay for prioritized burst.

Also attaching our latest evaluation-plan-notes and the MAP draft — please review the timeline column (we're aiming to close by end of May).

Appreciate a quick confirmation and proposed next steps. Elaine

Attachments: evaluation-plan-notes.docx, MAP_v1.3.pdf

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@novaplace.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP checkpoint + temporary SLA relief during evaluation

Elaine — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the docs. We saw the same spike on our telemetry (observability traces show elevated queue times on the dedicated pool during the overnight batch).

Quick summary of what we can do this week:
- Immediate: Move NovaPlace eval traffic to a priority lane (burst capacity) for the next 48 hours to bring p95 generation under 1.2s. Requires DB access window for cache warm-up — details below.
- Short amendment: We can offer a one-week SLA exception for the evaluation window with surcharged priority hours (we'll prepare an amendment).
- MAP update: we'll shift the "final verification" milestone to May 27 if you prefer to avoid re-runs; otherwise, we can keep May 31 close date and extend priority hours.

Action items for Redwood (owning teams in parentheses):
1) Schedule priority lane (Serving Ops) — Aditya to confirm timing 
2) Cache warm-up plan (Runtime Eng) — Neha to provide required sample prefixes and a 2-hr warm-up window
3) Draft amendment (Sales Legal) — Priyom to share language for 1-week exception and billing terms

I'll loop in Lauren for an executive-level update and to confirm approval for the one-week exception.

— Priyom

On attachments: MAP_v1.3.pdf received, we'll add an "SLA exception" row and return an updated map by EOD tomorrow.
